info.title: NEXORA implemented API
info.description: Development-only executable vertical slice. Only routes in this file exist. It is not production-ready; see SECURITY.md and the separate planned contract.

post.description: Returns a short-lived JWT and an opaque refresh token. Development mode only; do not store tokens in localStorage.
One-time rotation. A used refresh token is rejected; absolute session expiry does not extend.
Revokes the current session, invalidating its access tokens on subsequent requests.

get.description: Admin only. Password hashes are never returned.

post.description: Admin only; bcrypt password hash. Password must be at least 14 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes.
Admin only. Manual inventory; no device discovery.

patch.description: Admin only; partial update. Empty primary_ip clears the address; audit is transactional.

get.description: A source is a device/emitter. last_received_at is not proof of connectivity.

post.description: Admin only. Source token is returned once and stored hashed.
Admin only. Replaces the previous token immediately and activates ingestion; new token is shown once.
Admin only. Revokes token by disabling ingestion; safe to repeat. Does not assert the physical device is offline.

Private development L2-to-storage endpoint for a bounded ECS-inspired subset, not raw sensor ingestion. Batch is atomic and deduplicated by organization/source/timestamp/sequence. No rule detection or correlation occurs.

get.description: Uses a half-open [from,to) interval; timestamps are UTC. Offset pagination is bounded to 10,000 and is not a high-volume cursor.

post.description: Creates a MANUAL incident only. It is not a detection or correlated incident.
Six-state lifecycle. Containment is blocked (409) until human approval and verified execution are implemented. Closed-to-new requires a reason; resolved-to-closed requires root cause.

get.description: Real counts of stored records and manual incidents. Alerts are null and detection is explicitly not implemented. Window is half-open and limited to 90 days; defaults to the last 24 hours.
Admin and auditor only; newest first. The audit chain shares the operating database in this slice.
Verifies up to 10,000 entries from genesis, without an external anchor. A privileged database operator can still rewrite or truncate the chain.

AssetUpdate.description: Partial update. Empty primary_ip clears the address; null is treated as absent.

TaskUpdate.description: Partial update; an empty assignee_id or due_at clears that field.
